name: Núria Serrano
summary: Senior Mobile Engineer with 10 years of experience designing and optimizing high-traffic iOS and Android applications. Expert in native and cross-platform frameworks, focused on performance tuning, robust mobile architectures, and automated delivery pipelines. Proven record of scaling mobile products in the mobility, HR, and on-demand delivery sectors.

experience.title: Senior Mobile Engineer
experience.description: Led the refactoring of the core passenger booking flow using Swift and Kotlin, reducing application launch time by 28%. Orchestrated the integration of a GraphQL API layer that decreased mobile payload sizes by 40% across a user base of 5M+ active passengers. Collaborated with a team of 12 engineers to optimize CI/CD pipelines, reducing monthly build failures by 15%.

experience.title: Mobile Software Engineer
experience.description: Developed core employee-management features using React Native and REST APIs, supporting the scaling of the platform to 50k daily active users. Built custom native bridges to interface with biometric hardware, improving clock-in accuracy to 99.8%. Standardized Git branching strategies and automated App Store and Google Play deployments, reducing release cycle overhead from 3 days to 4 hours.

experience.title: Mobile Developer
experience.description: Engineered real-time tracking features for courier and customer applications in Swift and Kotlin, reducing location update latency by 150ms. Managed localized application state and offline-first persistence architectures to ensure reliable performance under low-connectivity environments. Contributed to a cross-functional squad of 8, delivering 15 major app updates that boosted checkout conversion rates by 4.2%.
